reviewed_by: Claude worker-retire implementer; root cause independently validated by a separate Claude subagent (worker-retire/validation.md, causal one-line fixture experiment); an independent diff review is still required before merge
reason: Test-only fix. The runtime-continuity acceptance bundles (tests/v3/runtime_continuity_bundle.py) copied a fixed allowlist of features from runtime-compatibility.json and omitted project.idle-retirement/v1, so since a73dd02 Core's idle retirement treated every fixture worker as an older release and never retired it; project-view-lease (runtime-continuity.spec.ts:222) and runtime-pane-recovery (:151) timed out waiting for retirement. The bundle manifest now declares every feature the source declares, as a release build does. Python: the mixed-release idle retirement file, with new tests that the acceptance bundle declares every release feature (fails on 03c704c) and that a worker of that release stays while a view or chat is open and retires once the closed view's grace has run out (fails on 03c704c), plus the existing older-release and quiescence-hold guards. Playwright: the two runtime-continuity journeys this fixes, re-selected after #1110 deselected them, on desktop and Chromium/WebKit 390.
exclusions: No product source changes; Core idle-retirement rules (feature gate, open chat, live view lease, command and view grace, quiesce blockers) are unchanged and covered by the existing selected file plus test_project_view_leases.py, which this diff does not touch. Other runtime-continuity journeys use the same bundles but do not start automatic admission with a short grace, or keep an open chat, so retirement does not run in them; the retained-continuity pytest acceptance (test_runtime_continuity_acceptance.py) never starts automatic admission and is excluded as a process-heavy suite unaffected beyond the manifest feature list the worker already accepts. No UI, frontend unit or native changes. Mobile 320/430 and compact profiles are excluded to keep CI narrow; 390 px Chromium/WebKit cover mobile.
